## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `vendor/bin/phpunit` passes
- [ ] `composer analyse` and `composer format` are clean
- [ ] Entry added under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] README / docs updated if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] New behaviour that changes what users see is off by default (or this is marked as breaking)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, real customer data or private code in the diff, tests or screenshots
